audience: businesses that send SMS reminders and alerts from a Spryng account

useCases.title: Check the SMS credit balance
useCases.text: Read the credit balance of the account. Check it before you send a large batch of messages.

useCases.title: Find messages that failed to deliver
useCases.text: Filter the sent messages by status failed and by date range. Open one message by id to see its status.

useCases.title: Trace messages by recipient or reference
useCases.text: Filter the sent messages by recipient number or by your own reference. Use the results to answer a customer.

useCases.title: Send an SMS now or at a set time
useCases.text: Send one SMS to up to 50 recipients. Use a scheduled time to send it later. Sending spends credits, and a sent message cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Cancel a scheduled reminder
useCases.text: Cancel a scheduled message before Spryng sends it. A message that was already sent cannot be cancelled.
